name: ai-feature-source-control
description: Group your Git changes by feature using Codex or Copilot. Review diffs, stage files, and manage commits across multiple repositories in VS Code.

commands.title: AI Feature Groups: Choose AI Provider
Unstage All Staged Changes in Repository
Revert All Unstaged Changes in Repository
AI Feature Groups: Reclassify Repository... (Uses More Tokens)
AI Feature Groups: Preview Classification Data (No AI Request)

aiFeatureGroups.provider.description: Use the Copilot VS Code Language Model API or an installed, authenticated Codex CLI.

aiFeatureGroups.copilotModelId.description: Optional exact Copilot Language Model API ID (e.g. from the model picker). Empty: ask which available Copilot model to use. Unsupported or unavailable IDs cause an explicit error.

aiFeatureGroups.codexModel.description: Optional Codex CLI model ID passed as --model on each request. Empty uses the Codex CLI built-in default; availability depends on authentication and plan.

aiFeatureGroups.codexReasoningEffort.description: Codex CLI reasoning effort passed as -c model_reasoning_effort. Model-dependent: unsupported levels produce a Codex error. "default" uses the CLI built-in default. The VS Code Copilot Language Model API does not provide an equivalent documented effort override.

aiFeatureGroups.codexExecutablePath.description: Automatically detect Codex CLI or the executable bundled with the official Codex VS Code extension. Optionally specify a custom executable path.

aiFeatureGroups.detailLevel.description: Semantic depth in Changes by Feature. Display-only: changing this setting never requests AI.

aiFeatureGroups.autoClassify.description: Reclassify modified files after a configurable delay only in repositories explicitly authorized in this session. False is recommended for strict AI usage control.

aiFeatureGroups.maxFilesPerBatch.description: Maximum number of files sent to the AI in one request.

aiFeatureGroups.maxDiffCharsPerFile.description: Maximum characters of diff content sent per file. Larger diffs are truncated.

aiFeatureGroups.maxTotalDiffCharsPerClas.description: Maximum Git diff excerpt characters PER REPOSITORY for each explicit classification. Limits input excerpts, not exact tokens; hierarchy levels 1/2/3 share the same analysis.

aiFeatureGroups.excludedFilePatterns.description: Additional glob patterns omitted from AI prompts; files are still shown in the tree. Known credential formats in other diffs are locally redacted but detection is not exhaustive.

aiFeatureGroups.maxFilesPerClassificatio.description: Maximum files whose diffs can be sent to the AI for one repository classification. Remaining changes stay visible with cached grouping or Uncategorized.

aiFeatureGroups.aiRequestTimeoutMs.description: Maximum duration of one Codex or Copilot classification/commit-message request before it is cancelled (milliseconds).

aiFeatureGroups.autoClassifyDelayMs.description: Debounce after Git changes before automatic classification (milliseconds). Larger values reduce repeated AI requests.
